name: The Oaks Shopping Center
description: The Oaks Shopping Center is a premier enclosed regional shopping destination in Thousand Oaks, California, offering visitors a comprehensive retail experience with major department store anchors and a diverse mix of specialty retailers. Located in the heart of the Conejo Valley, this established mall serves the affluent communities of Ventura County with over 180 stores and restaurants. The center combines classic mall shopping with modern amenities, making it the primary retail hub for Thousand Oaks and surrounding areas.
demographics: The Oaks Shopping Center attracts an affluent demographic from the Conejo Valley area, with visitors predominantly consisting of middle to upper-middle-class families with household incomes exceeding $100,000. The primary trade area includes well-educated professionals and families from Thousand Oaks, Westlake Village, and Newbury Park, typically aged 35-65, who value convenience and quality shopping experiences. Shopping patterns reflect a preference for both everyday necessities and discretionary purchases, with strong foot traffic during weekends and holidays from households seeking a mix of department store shopping, specialty retail, and dining options.
summary: The Oaks Shopping Center is Thousand Oaks' premier enclosed regional mall featuring major department stores, 180+ specialty retailers, and dining options serving the affluent Conejo Valley community.
